description: Review or rewrite extracted .docx/.pptx XML text segments with number and qualifier guards, preserving layout without binary base64 transfer (2 cr review / 3 cr deslop, sign-in required).

mode.description: Choose review for diagnostics or deslop for rewritten segments

pack.description: Scenario rule pack ID (defaults to executive-deck or business-brief)

segments.description: Ordered list of extracted text segments from the Office file (up to 400 items)

id.description: Stable segment identifier used to write edits back to XML

kind.description: Optional role such as title, body, table-cell, or speaker-note

text.description: Plain text content of the Office segment

name: dislop_office
